conversation.text:
Description: A private confrontation in the Billiard room reveals the lost engagement ring, what happened during the drunken incident, and the direct source of the conflict over the daughter’s disappearance.
Location: Billiard room (Billiard room)
Key Information:
  - The events take place in the Billiard room (Billiard room).
  - Person No. 9 is extremely dissatisfied with Person No. 6 due to their daughter’s disappearance and directly questions his responsibility.
  - Person No. 6 admits he argued with Person No. 9’s daughter and confirms that she had gotten drunk earlier; he also says that before the knock at the front door, he and Person No. 9’s daughter were in the Billiard room, but denies anything more serious.
  - During the conversation, the sound of a bottle shattering is heard again inside the villa; this sound matches what is heard in most other “04-” time nodes, forming a recurring clue.
  - Person No. 6 explicitly mentions for the first time that the engagement ring is missing, and says it fell when the front door was knocked on.
  - Person No. 9 confirms the engagement and sternly demands that Person No. 6 retrieve the ring and apologize to their daughter.
  - Person No. 6 verbally promises to take responsibility and carry out the demands to find the ring and apologize.
Characters:
  [Edmund Galley (Edmund Galley)] Person No. 6, a member of the Galley family, engaged to Person No. 9’s daughter.
    · Admits to arguing with Person No. 9’s daughter.
    · Confirms he did not intentionally tend to her emotions, leading to her excessive drinking.
    · Reveals that the engagement ring was lost when the front door was knocked on and has not yet been found.
    · Under pressure from Person No. 9, promises to retrieve the ring and apologize.
    · Admits that earlier he and Person No. 9’s daughter were in the Billiard room.
  [Person No. 9] Mrs. Dauer, Person No. 6’s future mother-in-law. Since the name is either Helen Dauer or Tony Dauer and Helen Dauer is a female name, the full name is confirmed, and Person No. 4 is Tony Dauer.
    · Severely interrogates Person No. 6 over the daughter’s disappearance and the ring being lost.
    · Emphasizes the importance of the engagement.
    · Demands that Person No. 6 take responsibility immediately, retrieve the ring, and repair the relationship.
